name: SaudiGovSent
description: The rapid expansion of mobile government (m-Government) platforms in Saudi Arabia has generated large volumes of user feedback, creating an opportunity for systematic, data-driven evaluation of public digital services. This study conducts a large-scale sentiment analysis of Arabic user reviews collected from five major Saudi m-Government applications, Absher Business, Tawakkalna, Sehhaty, Nusuk, and Najiz. A dataset comprising 84,000 reviews was constructed and classified into positive and negative sentiment categories.
